leadText:
Yellow Rock Isle (Japanese: 黄岩島 Isle) is an -exclusive island in Johto. It is found in the Whirl Islands archipelago, located between Red Rock Isle and Blue Point Isle.

The island got its name from the yellow rocks that make up its geography, and even the city streets are colored yellow. The islanders are also particularly fond of .

Yellow Rock Isle traditions largely revolve around . Residents build their homes on Corsola nests near the shore, and each Corsola is considered part of the family unit. Additionally, artisans make jewelry out of Corsola horns here.

It also relies on many kinds of to fuel its fishing and farming industries.
